svg.title: PFC droplet inventory and phase closure
svg.desc: Droplet liquid radius a, density rho_PFC and mass md become vapor radius Rv at chosen p and Tb; molar mass M and gas constant Ru set volume. Heat Q and mass flux j change vapor inventory over time.
